meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

foundation.review_note: Baseline source ownership/reference contract checked against PHP routing, hosted business data, private per-chat JSON and deployment documentation. Hashes detect future changes but do not assert exhaustive semantic correctness or issue completion.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed issue-first gh development versus plain-Git hosting, explicit source/doc receipts, regenerated index behavior and GitHub-only tracking tests. Map generation no longer claims an unused remote blog source. CI does not auto-approve review hashes.
